title: Package
description: Generic transportable physical package, reusable across food, parcels and freight. Physical properties and contents are described here; origin, destination, requested mode and handling requirements belong to the referencing ShipmentRequest. W3DS application-specific schema; DCSA-informed, not DCSA-conformant.

ownerEName.description: W3DS identity of party owning or sending package

name.description: Short name of package or goods

weight.description: Gross package weight, including packaging; unit codes use UN/CEFACT notation.

dimensions.description: Outer package dimensions; all three measurements use the specified unit.

unit.description: UN/CEFACT length unit code (millimetre, centimetre, metre, inch or foot).

contents.description: Optional list of goods and declared value per line; inline contents, not separate vault envelopes.

metadata.description: Optional application-specific extensions; must not redefine standardized fields.

packageType.description: Optional physical form, for example box, pallet, parcel, crate or container; extensible free text.

packageContents.description: Contents line of a package, supporting per-SKU declared value. Inspired by DCSA cargo/commodity concepts, not identical to its objects.

declaredValue.description: Declared value for this contents line

metadata.description: Optional application-specific extensions; must not redefine standardized fields.

monetaryAmount.description: Non-negative monetary amount in ISO 4217 currency; shared FMaaS structure.
